request.spec:
The audit viewer, filtered by a name, now also lists the matching lines of the sheet's descendants
(each sheet's lines newest first, sheets by id, after this sheet's own lines and before the lines
from the sheet a person came from).
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The audit viewer, filtered by a name, now also lists the matching lines of the sheet's descendants
(each sheet's lines newest first, sheets by id, after this sheet's own lines and before the lines
from the sheet a person came from).

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
When the audit viewer is filtered by a name, it now also lists the matching lines from the sheet's descendants. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests.

**Order of the lines:** this sheet's own matching lines come first, newest first. Then come the matching lines of each descendant, with the sheets taken in id order and each sheet's lines newest first. The lines from the sheet a transferred-in person came from still come last.

**The change:** it's all in `src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/auditview/RespondWithAuditLines.java`. It uses the existing `Settings.descendants(sheet)`, which already finds children, grandchildren and so on, each once, sorted by id. So nothing changed in the stored data or the front end. I also updated the comment in `audit.GET.yml` to describe the new behaviour.

**Unchanged:** with no filter, the viewer still shows only this sheet's own lines.

After the passing run I only reworded a code comment in that Java file, so the test result still applies.
